text.body:
prahlādahlādahetuṃ sakalaguṇagaṇaṃ saccidānandamātraṃ sauhyāsahyogramūrtiṃ sadabhayamariśaṅkhau ramāṃ bibhrataṃ ca। aṃhassaṃhāradakṣaṃ vidhibhavavihagendrendrādivandyaṃ rakṣovakṣovidārollasadamaladṛśaṃ naumi lakṣmīnṛsiṃhama॥1॥
vāmāṅkasthadharākarāñjalipuṭapremātihṛṣṭāntaraṃ sīmātītaguṇaṃ phaṇīndraphaṇagaṃ śrīmānyapādāṃbujama। kāmādyākaracakraśaṅkhasuvaroddhāmābhayodyatkaraṃ sāmādīḍyavarāharūpamamalaṃ he mānasemaṃ smara॥2॥
kolāya lasadākalpajālāya vanamāline। nīlāya nijabhaktaughapālāya haraye namaḥ॥3॥
dhātrīṃ śubhaguṇapātrīmādāya aśeṣavibudhamodaya। śeṣetamimadoṣe dhātuṃ hātuṃ ca śaṃkinaṃ śaṃke॥4॥
namo'stu haraye yukti giraye nirjitāraye। samastagurave kalpatarave paravedināma॥5॥
॥iti śrīvādirājayatikṛtaṃ varāhapañcakaṃ saṃpūrṇama॥
